typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		bus_a_id_c as integer,
		bus_a_extl_n as string,
		lastStatementDate as timestamp,
		lastActivityDate as timestamp,
		bus_a_key_type_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_eff_x as timestamp,
		bus_a_extl_stat_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_key_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_n_c as string,
		system_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_end_x as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		bus_a_id_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_n as string,
		lastStatementDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		lastActivityDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		bus_a_key_type_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_eff_x as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		bus_a_extl_stat_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_key_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_n_c as string,
		system_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_end_x as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		bus_a_id_c,
		bus_a_extl_n,
		lastStatementDate,
		lastActivityDate,
		bus_a_key_type_c,
		bus_a_extl_eff_x,
		bus_a_extl_stat_c,
		bus_a_extl_key_c,
		bus_a_extl_n_c,
		system_c,
		bus_a_extl_end_x),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
